name: Uka
source:
The physical manifestation of Mayuko's true desire.

Although she looks like a kid, Uka has strong mother instinct just like her vessel and a romantic heart.
She's free spirited and naive girl as well.

In order to save Mayuko, she will teach Isamu the way of sex.
